findings.title: Null strategy path skips rolling-updates feature enablement
findings.body: In operator/src/test/java/org/keycloak/operator/testsuite/integration/UpgradeTest.java createInitialDeployment() returns early when updateStrategy == null without setting FeatureSpec enabledFeatures to rolling-updates. The docs in this same PR state the Operator will fail while in preview unless rolling-updates is enabled. As a result the parameterized runs with null strategy deploy a CR without the required feature and will fail or test different behavior than the RECREATE runs, making the test setup inconsistent and invalid.

findings.title: Recreate exit code changed from 4 to 3 breaks existing automation
findings.body: In quarkus/runtime/src/main/java/org/keycloak/quarkus/runtime/compatibility/CompatibilityResult.java RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE is changed from 4 to 3 and new FEATURE_DISABLED=4 reuses the old value. Any script, CI/CD pipeline, or Operator logic built against the previous release that treats exit 4 as recreate-required will now misinterpret recreate as feature-disabled and vice versa. The docs are updated but there is no compatibility handling, so existing automation silently takes the wrong upgrade path.

findings.title: Feature gate and new exit codes not asserted
findings.body: In quarkus/tests/integration/src/test/java/org/keycloak/it/cli/dist/UpdateCommandDistTest.java testFeatureNotEnabled only covers the metadata subcommand and only checks the error message, and testWrongVersions never asserts exit codes. After this PR introduces exit 4 for feature-disabled and changes recreate from 4 to 3, there is no test verifying those exit codes or that check also enforces the gate. Regressions in exit-code contract documented in update-compatibility.adoc would go undetected.

findings.title: Rolling strategy documented as supported but has no field value
findings.body: In docs/guides/operator/advanced-configuration.adoc the Supported Updates Types section lists Rolling Updates and Recreate Updates, but the Possible field values table only documents <not set> and Recreate with no value for selecting Rolling. A reader following the docs cannot configure a rolling update and cannot tell what spec.update.strategy value enables it, making the documented feature unusable.
